name: Klaviyo
description: Klaviyo lets agents read campaigns, flows, lists, segments, profiles, and performance reports, and draft campaigns in the signed-in Klaviyo account. Each user signs in through the browser with an Owner, Admin, or Manager role.

prompts.text: Which email campaigns had the highest revenue last month?
Summarize the performance of my welcome and abandoned cart flows.
Draft an email campaign for the new summer collection, but do not schedule it.

apps.name: Klaviyo
apps.description: Campaigns, flows, segments, and reports, over Klaviyo's MCP server with browser sign-in.
